title: parseVtt reads cue identifiers and hour-less timings as WebVTT writes them
body:
## Summary
parseVtt matched only hh:mm:ss.ttt timings and kept every non-header line as text, so an mm:ss transcript read as nothing and a cue identifier was glued onto the cue before it.

## Description
desk/src/lib/library/vtt.ts:5 `^(\d\d):(\d\d):(\d\d)\.(\d\d\d) --> ` - WebVTT allows the hours to be left out; desk/src/lib/library/vtt.ts:11-13 pushed any non-header line, including a cue identifier (the line right before a timing line, after a blank one). The windows are what retrieval embeds and the pick quotes (desk/src/lib/desk/pick.ts:39). Fixed: optional hours; an identifier line is dropped. A YouTube-shaped sample reads identically (VTT-1).

## Flow
- a transcript timed 00:01.000 --> 00:04.000 is placed in <data>/lessons
- before: parseVtt returns [] and the lesson has no windows; after: every cue at its time
- an identifier "2" no longer ends the previous cue text

## Expected impact
Transcripts from sources other than YouTube read correctly; YouTube transcripts read the same.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - spec-valid transcripts read as cues
Before: mm:ss sample 0 of 2 cues; identifier sample 2 of 3 cues carry a leaked id
After: 2 of 2; 0 of 3; YouTube sample unchanged
Method: gate - new tools/library-rules-test.cjs VTT-2/VTT-3 red before, VTT-1 green before and after
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence:
desk/src/lib/library/vtt.ts:5 (before) timing regex requires hours
VTT-2 before: text "first line 2", "second line intro-3"
VTT-3 before: []

title: A lesson-vector cache that cannot be written is said once
body:
## Summary
writeCache swallowed a failed write of embeddings.json, so every later start re-embedded every lesson with nothing in the log to say why.

## Description
desk/src/lib/library/lessons.ts writeCache: `} catch { try { rmSync(tmp ...) } catch {} }`. The vectors still serve the running process, so the failure is invisible until the next start pays the embedding engine for every window again. The same data dir other writers say their failure (store.ts writeSession logs; learners.ts writeBook throws). Fixed: one console.error naming the file and the consequence.

## Flow
- embeddings.json cannot be replaced (a directory, a lock, a full disk)
- before: silent; after: one line, the pick still answers, no temp file left

## Expected impact
An operator can see why the desk keeps calling the embedder at start.

## Evaluation
Claim: resilience - a failed cache write leaves a trace
Before: 0 log lines on a failed cache write
After: 1 line naming embeddings.json
Method: gate - tools/library-rules-test.cjs CACHE-1 red then green
Result: better
Gate: policy-tighten
evidence: desk/src/lib/library/lessons.ts writeCache (before) `} catch { try { rmSync(tmp, { force: true }); } catch {} }`

title: Lesson windows and queries are embedded with one role on an asymmetric model
body:
## Summary
lessons.ts embeds the transcript windows and the problem query through the same call with no role, while the default model (nomic-embed-text) is trained with search_document/search_query prefixes.

## Description
desk/src/lib/library/lessons.ts:79 (windows) and :137 (query) both call embed({ texts, use: "lesson-window" }); desk/src/lib/engines/embed.ts:14 defaults OLLAMA_EMBED_MODEL to nomic-embed-text. Registry technique retrieval/embedding-lifecycle, "The role is a fifth input": name the role at both call sites and put it in the stamp and any content-keyed cache - the cache digest (lessons.ts digestOf) and CACHE_VERSION would move with it. The model is env-configurable, so the prefix must be per model. Whether recall improves on these 8 lessons is the open figure.

## Flow
- the hint route picks a lesson and asks bestWindow for the nearest window to the problem
- today: query and windows share one role; the technique predicts quietly worse recall
- fix: document role on windows, query role on the problem, role in the digest

## Expected impact
The seek target inside a lesson may land closer to the method the problem needs. A cache rebuild once.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - seek-target recall
Before: no labelled set; recall unmeasured
After: needs a labelled problem -> window set run against local Ollama with and without prefixes
Method: simulation - the figure needs live embeddings from the operator Ollama; gates forbid live model calls, so neither this round nor a Lane B worker can take it
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: none
evidence:
desk/src/lib/library/lessons.ts:79 `await embed({ texts: w.map((x) => x.text), use: "lesson-window" })`
desk/src/lib/library/lessons.ts:104 `await embed({ texts: [query], use: "lesson-window" })`
registry: knowledge/software-engineering/llm-agent/prompt-and-context/retrieval/techniques/embedding-lifecycle.md "The role is a fifth input"

title: A transcript added while the desk runs is not seen until a restart
body:
## Summary
lessonWindows caches [] for a missing transcript and ensureVectors publishes the vector map once, so a transcript placed after the first pick is ignored for the life of the process.

## Description
desk/src/lib/library/lessons.ts lessonWindows: `cache.set(id, w)` also for w = []; ensureVectors returns `vectors` forever once built. A lesson whose file arrives later reads as "no windows" (pick seeks 0:00) until restart. The empty and never-returned states render identically to "this lesson has no transcript".

## Flow
- the desk starts before data/lessons/<id>.en.vtt exists; a pick asks for it
- the operator drops the transcript in
- before: still 0:00 until restart; fix: do not cache an empty read, and rebuild vectors when a lesson gains windows

## Expected impact
Seeking works as soon as a transcript is present. Costs one existsSync per pick for a missing file.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - a placed transcript is used without a restart
Before: predicted: 0 of 1 late transcripts used
After: predicted: 1 of 1
Method: simulation - walked the two caches; the vectors half touches ensureVectors publishing, which the engines suite pins (HL4), so it wants its own gate run
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence:
desk/src/lib/library/lessons.ts lessonWindows `const w = existsSync(f) ? windows(...) : []; cache.set(id, w);`
ensureVectors `if (vectors) return vectors;`
instrument: A library-rules-test case: call lessonWindows(id) with no transcript, write the .vtt, call bestWindow(id) and assert a window past 0:00 (red today: [] is cached and the vectors map omits the lesson).
